config_name: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra — Dimensity 9400+, 16GB RAM, 512GB, 14.6" Dynamic AMOLED 2X 120Hz + Book Cover Keyboard Slim S11/S12 Ultra (price includes Slim cover; Pro Keyboard w/ trackpad option noted).

specs.storage_type: UFS soldered + dedicated microSDXC slot (up to 2TB)
specs.speakers: Quad AKG-tuned speakers (larger chambers than S11)
specs.keyboard_notes: Book Cover Keyboard Slim S11/S12 Ultra included in price ($299.99 reg cover): scissor keys + AI key, NO trackpad. Pro Keyboard with trackpad $499.99 reg/$299.99 sale (BBY 20142500) is the premium typing option
specs.pen_support: S Pen INCLUDED in box (Bluetooth air actions, 4096 pressure, IP68)
specs.os: Android 16 / One UI 8 at launch (Android 17 / One UI 9 current); 7 years OS+security updates

battery.notes: 11600 mAh (~44.4Wh) cell, 45W USB-PD charging (charger not in box). No official video-hours claim; users report ~8-11h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tablet $2,099.00 reg / $1,699.00 sale (BBY SKU 19652312) + Book Cover Keyboard Slim Ultra $299.99 reg / $179.99 sale (BBY 19433657) = $2,398.99 at regular prices. Cover-only price: Slim $299.99 reg/$179.99 sale; Pro Keyboard w/ trackpad $499.99/$299.99 (BBY 20142500). BBY sale combined total ~$1,878.99. RAM/storage inferred from spec sheet per ANDROID_LIST caveat.     1TB Ultra tier not stocked new at BBY; 5G variant omitted.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 1699 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: One of the most capable Android tablets you can buy.
A disappointing chipset lets down an otherwise fantastic media and gaming machine.
Totally ridiculous, but that hasn't stopped me liking it.

praises: 16GB RAM is the tier for DeX power users: a dozen windows plus emulated Linux (Termux/Boxer) without app reloads
14.6" AMOLED at 5.1mm thin — MacBook-sized canvas that still weighs 692g
S Pen in the box — no extra $199 accessory tax like the iPad Pro
512GB soldered + microSD slot covers both speed and archive storage without cloud fees
Full Galaxy phone continuity: Quick Share, clipboard sync, calls/texts on the tablet
complaints: The priced-in Slim cover has NO trackpad; the trackpad Pro Keyboard adds $499.99 reg on top of a $2,400 total
Regular price ($2,399 with cover) crosses into MacBook Pro territory while still running Android apps
App optimization still uneven on 14.6" — stretched phone UIs persist
BBY stock of the 16/512 tier is thinner than the 12/256 — colour options sell out and refills lag

design_philosophy: The top stocked Ultra tier is Samsung's proof that Android tablets can be configured like laptops — 16GB RAM and 512GB match mid-tier ultrabooks, aimed at DeX power users who keep many windows and heavy apps resident. It is also where the line's pricing logic strains: at regular price with the keyboard included it exceeds most Windows ultrabooks, so it is really a sale-price flagship.
rating_notes: Pro scores from What Hi-Fi/TechRadar/Android Police Tab S11 Ultra reviews (gap-fill 2026-11-25). Ratings inferred from the Tab S11 11" 12/256 anchor per SHARED-tab-s11.md: Ultra deltas (screen_size 8.2, portability 7.6, battery +0.4, productivity +0.7, creative_work +0.5, gaming −0.2, keyboard_trackpad 6.5 for Slim cover w/o trackpad) plus 16GB/512GB tier bumps (+0.4 productivity, +0.3 creative_work, +0.3 ai_ml for headroom). Ecosystem 7.0 = DeX + Galaxy-phone parity per SHARED calibration. Brightness figures are Samsung marketing approximations. User sentiment is disclosed synthesis, not verbatim quotes. RAM tier inferred from spec sheet, not BBY title.
standouts: 16GB RAM + 512GB: the only Android tablet tier that matches ultrabook memory specs
Best DeX canvas in retail (14.6" AMOLED) with S Pen + microSD included
At BBY sale (~$1,879 incl. cover) it undercuts every comparable iPad Pro 13 bundle
dealbreakers: Trackpad only via the $499.99 Pro Keyboard
At $2,399 regular with cover it costs laptop money while running tablet apps
